name: Chihiro Sato
source:
At twenty-two, is a rising star in the Black Rose Revue, landing a significant role in 'Thorns of the Royal Court.'

However, her swift ascent is overshadowed by cryptic letters from a mysterious E.M., tracing back to her time at the academy.

[From [url=https://yamino.itch.io/black-rose-revue]itch.io[/url]]
